findings.title: Incorrect phase transition condition allows invalid state
findings.body: The change replaces `state.phase === "running"` with `state.phase !== "failed"`, which allows the transition to `"passed"` from any phase except `"failed"`. This violates the intended state machine: a review should only transition to `"passed"` when it was previously `"running"`, not from `"cancelled"` or other states. The new condition also introduces a potential inconsistency where a review could be marked as `"passed"` after being `"cancelled"`, which may not align with the application's logic.

summary.problem: The phase transition condition incorrectly allows a review to move to "passed" from any state except "failed".
summary.done_well: The change is minimal and targets a specific condition in the state machine logic.
